searches.query: Exactly what does replacing a torn tent floor cost? Please give me the fixed price.

chunks.text: Published repair charges  The repair workshop offers a tent pole-section replacement for USD 18 per section and a sleeping-bag zipper-slider replacement for USD 25. These prices cover the named repair work only. Any transport charge is stated in the individual quotation. Other repairs, including a torn tent floor, require a quote after assessment. There is no published flat price for a tent-floor replacement.  A manufacturing fault approved under warranty is handled under the product's warranty terms rather than automatically charged as a paid repair. An accidental tear or wear outside the warranty can still be assessed for paid repair. The workshop tells the customer the scope and price before work begins. The customer must approve the quotation; sending an item for assessment is not approval for an unspecified charge.  Active members receive priority queue handling but pay the same published repair prices. Priority is not a completion guarantee.

Tent manufacturing warranty  Tents have a 24-month warranty for manufacturing defects, beginning on the purchase date. A stitching seam that separates during normal use can qualify. The customer must provide proof of purchase and clear photos so the repair team can assess the failure. The warranty team chooses repair or replacement after assessment; support cannot promise a cash refund before that decision.  Damage from animals, sharp objects, storms beyond the tent's rating, ordinary fabric wear, or incorrect storage is outside this warranty. Accidental damage can still be sent for a paid repair assessment. A quotation must be approved before paid repair work starts. The repair-price guide lists the fixed fees that are currently published; some repairs require an individual quote.  Customers should dry a tent before packing it for inspection. Do not include fuel canisters, batteries, food, or personal belongings. An approved manufacturing-defect claim receives a prepaid ground label.

Drying and storing outdoor equipment  Dry tents completely before putting them into long-term storage. Moisture trapped in folded fabric can cause mold, odors, and damage to coatings. Brush off loose dirt gently and follow the product's cleaning instructions. Do not use a washing machine or household bleach on a tent. A storage problem is not automatically a manufacturing defect.  Keep sleeping bags dry and store them loosely when space allows. Long-term compression can reduce loft. The product label controls the permitted washing method; different insulation and fabrics may need different treatment. A support agent should not infer washing-machine compatibility merely from the generic sleeping-bag category.  Rechargeable equipment should follow its manufacturer's charging and storage instructions. If a battery is swollen, leaking, or damaged, use the battery-safety process. Generic care advice does not authorize continued charging. This article does not supply a temperature specification for every model, a chemical treatment recipe, or a prediction of remaining battery life.

Refund allocation for discounted bundles  When a bundle has one discounted purchase price, allocate that price across its items in proportion to their individual prices at the time of purchase. Refunding one eligible item returns that allocated paid amount. It does not return the item's current price or its undiscounted original price. Retaining other items does not by itself cancel the allocation.  The camping starter kit contains a lantern listed at USD 30, a stove listed at USD 50, and a carry case listed at USD 20. Their individual prices total USD 100. When the customer paid USD 80 for the kit, the allocated paid amounts are USD 24 for the lantern, USD 40 for the stove, and USD 16 for the case. These amounts total the USD 80 actually paid.  The allocation determines money, not return eligibility. Check the condition, return window, gift status, and transport restrictions separately.

Outlet and final-sale products  Products marked final sale in the outlet cannot be returned merely because the customer changes their mind, chooses the wrong color, or finds a lower price later. The final-sale marking appears on the product page and the order confirmation. A general store promotion does not make a product final sale unless the product is specifically marked that way.  Final sale does not remove the manufacturing warranty. A defective outlet tent follows the tent warranty assessment process, including proof of purchase and photos. Cosmetic wear that was disclosed on the outlet listing is not a new manufacturing defect. Support must distinguish a disclosed condition from a fault that arose later.  If the delivered outlet product does not match the listing, report that problem within 14 calendar days after delivery. Keep photographs of the product and the packaging. The support team checks the listing and the received item before arranging a remedy. The 14-day mismatch report window is a separate route from the manufacturing warranty.

Swollen, leaking, or damaged rechargeable batteries  Stop using or charging a rechargeable device if its battery swells, leaks, or is visibly damaged. Do not send it through the ordinary returns process. The store's regular ground return label is not an approved way to ship a damaged battery. Contact the product safety team through the support form and choose the battery-safety category.  Provide the product model, purchase reference, a description of the damage, and photographs when it is safe to take them. The team gives the customer instructions for the specific product and location. Support agents must not improvise a packaging method or tell customers to remove a swollen battery. Follow the device manufacturer's safety instructions while waiting for the team.  The general shipping article permits certain undamaged battery products to travel by ground. That permission does not apply to a damaged battery. Whether the item qualifies for a warranty remedy is assessed separately from how it can be handled safely.

Oversize delivery for kayaks and cargo boxes  Kayaks and rigid roof cargo boxes are oversize products. Delivery to an eligible address in the contiguous United States costs USD 35 per order containing oversize items. Neither the ordinary free-shipping threshold nor the membership threshold waives this fee. Adding a small accessory to the order does not turn the oversize shipment into an ordinary parcel.  Oversize deliveries use a scheduled ground carrier. Express parcel service is not available for these products. The carrier contacts the customer to arrange an appointment after the shipment is ready. The documentation does not provide a fixed appointment date for any particular order. Support must check the live shipment record before discussing an actual delivery appointment.  At delivery, inspect the outer packaging before signing and photograph visible transport damage. If damage is discovered afterward, use the delivery-damage reporting policy. Store pickup may be available for an oversize item when the chosen store has stock.

Camping fuel and stove returns  The online store sells empty camping stoves and accessories but does not ship filled fuel canisters. Fuel is sold for store collection only where a store is authorized to stock it. A stove listing does not mean fuel is included. Customers should check the compatible fuel type in the product instructions before buying fuel separately.  Never include a used or full fuel canister in a stove return. Remove any fuel container before arranging an eligible stove return and follow the manufacturer's instructions for making the stove safe. If the stove has leaked or appears unsafe, contact support for the product-specific procedure instead of using an ordinary label.  An unused stove bought online follows the standard return policy unless it was marked final sale. A stove bought as part of the starter kit uses the discounted-bundle allocation for its paid item value. The allocation does not authorize sending fuel through the mail.

Import taxes are not refunded by the store. Direct size or color exchanges are unavailable for international orders; return an eligible item and place a new order instead. Availability, exchange rates, and customs clearance times for a particular order are not maintained in these policy pages.

answer.answer: There is no fixed price for replacing a torn tent floor. This repair requires an individual quote after assessment, and the customer must approve the quotation before work begins.
